name: nexus
description: Nexus: end-to-end encrypted notes and sync. This is the root of the workspace that holds the encryption, the merge, the server, the Obsidian plugin, the agent library and command and the linking job; the probe is standalone.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nexus/crypto && npm run build --workspace @nexus/agent && npm run build --workspace @nexus/linker && npm run build --workspace nexus-obsidian
scripts.check: npm run check:actions && npm run check:audit-test && npm run check:release && npm run build --workspace @nexus/crypto && npm run build --workspace @nexus/agent && npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace @nexus/linker && npm run build --workspace nexus-obsidian && npm run test
